description: Add networks to every account in the org. Networks already on the org are kept. When an account needs an onchain change on a new network (a deployment or a signer sync), this creates one proposal that covers every network: it returns networksAdded false and the proposal. The proposal sits on the Treasury account, or on the Root account when the Treasury itself needs an update; check 'accounts signers <address>' on that account before signing. Sign it on the web via the returned signUrl, or with 'transactions sign <id>' from a local key that is a signer on that account. On a multisig, run 'transactions update-gas-estimation <id>' before the last signature. When no onchain change is needed, the networks are added right away and networksAdded is true. Use 'accounts networks' for the networks already enabled and 'chains list' for the supported ones. Returns 400 SMART_ACCOUNT_MERKLE_TRANSACTION_IN_PROGRESS while another signer or network change is pending. Requires owner-scoped API key.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounts_add-networks
